title: The Great Coastal Fog
skyStory: Exactly half lit, the moon has drifted out of Aquarius and into Pisces, where everything goes soft at the edges. Fog rolls in off the water like a giant cat stretching across the coast. The moon can't see a thing and loves it. Mars keeps bumping into constellations. Saturn has turned on its fog lights and is driving extremely slowly.

reading: Morning fog, the thick coastal kind, and the Tiger can't see three steps ahead. Good. Today isn't a day for plans. It's a day for the next step only. Take it. Then the next. By lunch you'll be somewhere better than you would have planned.

The fog is also a gentle cover for receiving. Nobody can see you being looked after today, so let someone do it: a coworker covering a task, a friend dropping off something you mentioned once. The [[Six of Pentacles]] reversed has been patient all month. Today, finally, you receive without keeping score. The fog keeps your secret.
joel.mission: Walk somewhere in the fog, or pretend you are, and notice three sounds that seem closer than they are.
joel.omen: A foghorn, or any long low sound. You're on course; keep going slowly and steadily.

reading: Fog suits you, secretly. The Wood Rat navigates by whisker and memory, and you know every turn of your day without needing to see it. While everyone else is squinting, you'll glide.

The Pisces moon softens your edges too, and something you've been firm about all month can relax just slightly. Not give in. Just soften. The [[Eight of Swords]] reversed reveals the blindfold was never tied; you can take it off whenever you like. Around 7 pm the fog lifts in one sudden sweep, and the shore appears all at once, sparkling, like it's been waiting for you to look up.
nancy.mission: Let one small rule you hold yourself to slide today, and notice that nothing at all falls apart.
nancy.omen: A bird singing in the fog where you can't see it. Help is closer than it looks; just ask.
nancy.stoneWhy: earth to stand on in the mist

together.text: Fog day. Neither of you needs to do anything impressive. Send each other one photo of something soft: a blanket, a cloud, a cat, a sweater sleeve. The prize for the softest photo is an extra-long nap, awarded by the Pisces moon personally.

game.intro: The fog rolled in and swallowed the harbour. Saturn wants to hear it from inside the soup.
game.prompt: A foghorn, a buoy bell or a gull lost in the mist. Pick one and give it everything.
